caption: The drawing depicts a scene with a tall tree that has a wide canopy of leaves, rendered in brown and tan shades. The tree is positioned on a rounded, elevated base. To the right of the tree, there is a seated human figure that appears to be female, with light brown skin and wearing a headdress or cap. She is sitting on a small platform or stack of objects and holding a large, oval-shaped object with a textured pattern resembling a bird or feathered animal in her lap. The figure has one arm resting on her knee and the other arm draped across the object. The circular base of the entire composition is decorated with profile images of human faces and a central flower motif, all outlined in similar brown hues. The background of the drawing is left plain and uncolored, focusing attention on the central objects.
title: Female Figure
